reviewed_guards: Fresh active owner role checks; staff cannot read owner Meta connections, assets or bindings, or mutate connection state.
No token, secret or external asset identifier in frontend projections; independent encrypted token storage.
OAuth exact reviewed Business Login URL/config; bounded one-use state plus secure HttpOnly SameSite cookie; state committed consumed before network.
Callback and discovery release DB transaction during network then revalidate owner/configuration/connection revision before persistence.
Only exact three read scopes plus automatic public_profile accepted; unconsented write and other extra grants rejected.
Provider URLs, paths, response sizes and pagination bounded; redirects and proxy environment disabled; credential-bearing transport errors/logs sanitized.
Actual main middleware preserves Meta no-referrer and no-store including 303/200/403/422; unrelated route Referrer-Policy and CSP unchanged.
Disconnect requires displayed revision; stale tabs cannot disconnect a reauthorized connection.
Active-only customer/platform and global asset uniqueness; explicit disconnect permits a new history row; original request replay remains inactive.
Migration only creates five empty Meta tables and their indexes; no existing-data backfill or schema edits.
No publish, comment reply, scheduling, or staff operational capabilities claimed or exposed by this phase.
